svg.text: Inline help for grouping, render, timelapse, hardware and editor parameters.

g.text: Grouping threshold
Controls same-camera-angle strictness.
Higher values require stronger visual agreement.
Related: ORB features · minimum matches · capture-time window
Trail hardware
Auto · CPU · GPU · GPU+CPU are separate engine policies.
CUDA/OpenCL acceleration is used only when the installed OpenCV backend supports it.
Acceleration failures safely fall back to CPU.
Timelapse export
FPS, maximum video side and codec are independent controls.
The codec field accepts a four-character OpenCV code such as mp4v.
Timelapse hardware can be selected independently from grouping/trail.
Thumbnail performance
Viewport-aware loading avoids decoding every preview at once.
Decoded LRU cache is bounded at 128 thumbnails / 40 MB.
Off-screen references are released and large workspaces can pause preview work.
Engine compatibility
One-line installers verify the current hardware-policy flags.
An incompatible older tihulu installation is upgraded automatically.
Recheck confirms the updated executable before processing.
Local processing
The GUI delegates work to the installed tihulu engine.
Source frames remain on the computer; originals are not modified.
Photo-editor settings and group curation stay non-destructive.
